items.t: Lower intake manifold gasket leaks coolant
items.job: Replace lower intake manifold gaskets and refill coolant
items.note: If coolant got into the oil and damaged bearings, or the engine overheated, expect much more.

items.t: Passlock anti-theft no-start
items.job: Replace ignition lock cylinder and Passlock sensor
items.note: Some shops use a bypass module instead, which can cost less.

items.t: Oil can drip onto the exhaust and catch fire (recalls)
items.job: Replace front valve cover and gasket (recall)
items.note: Free under GM recall. Check your VIN or ask a Chevrolet dealer.

items.t: Ignition can be bumped out of Run (recall)
items.job: Install ignition key insert or key cover (recall)
items.note: Free under GM recall. Check your VIN or ask a Chevrolet dealer.

items.t: Fuel pressure regulator leak can cause a backfire (recall)

items.note: Free under GM recall. Check your VIN or ask a Chevrolet dealer.

items.t: Front brake caliper bolts may be loose (recall)
items.note: Free under GM recall. Check your VIN. Damaged parts may need replacing.

items.t: 4-speed automatic slips or shifts harshly
items.note: A solenoid, valve body or fluid service fix can cost far less if caught early.

items.t: Head or intake gasket coolant leak
items.job: Replace intake manifold gaskets and refill coolant
items.note: If a head gasket failed, expect much more. Overheating can warp the heads.
